name: Bowling Green State University
tuition_note: 2026-27 Ohio resident (in-state) full-time undergraduate tuition & fees (instructional + general fees) $5,727.60/semester x 2 = $11,455.20/yr, from bgsu.edu/bursar Tuition_and_Fees_2026-2027 page. Housing is room only; rates vary by hall from ~$3,380/sem (Kreischer standard double) to ~$4,340/sem (Centennial/Falcon Heights). Reported figure uses standard double at Kreischer ($3,380/sem x 2 = $6,760/yr); board (meal plans) not included ($4,464-$6,014/yr).
